title: External reader sees an active incident notice on the status page during an outage
asA: external reader visiting the status page during an active incident
iWant: the page to surface active incident notices with a stable structure the operator has populated
soThat: I see what the operator has said about the incident, when it started, and how bad it is, without hunting for a Twitter thread

acceptanceCriteria.description: When one or more incident notices are active, the status page renders a notices region above the component list; each notice is a distinct element carrying title, body, severity, startedAt and (optionally) componentIds as machine-readable fields.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the operator has posted two active incident notices, one with componentIds referencing two declared components and one without
acceptanceCriteria.when: the status page is rendered and the notices region is queried
acceptanceCriteria.then: the notices region contains exactly two notice elements, each with a title field, a body field, a severity field, and a startedAt field; the first notice element carries a componentIds field naming the two referenced components, the second notice element either omits the componentIds field or renders it as an empty list

acceptanceCriteria.description: The severity field on each notice is one of a fixed enum (info, warning, critical); no other value is renderable.
acceptanceCriteria.given: notices exist at each of the three severities
acceptanceCriteria.when: the status page is rendered and every notice element's severity field is inspected
acceptanceCriteria.then: every severity value is one of info, warning, or critical; no notice renders with any other severity value

acceptanceCriteria.description: When no notices are active, the notices region is either absent from the rendered document or clearly labelled as empty; no stale notice from a resolved incident appears.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the operator has resolved every previously active incident and no notice is currently active
acceptanceCriteria.then: the rendered document either contains no notices region element or contains a notices region element carrying an emptyState marker; no notice element from any previously active incident is present
